help.body:
📖 *Freedom Bot Help*

① `/start` — Dashboard
② `/users` — Manage users, UUIDs and inbound assignments
③ `/nodes` — Manage REALITY and XHTTP inbounds
④ `/traffic` — User traffic; `/inboundtraffic` — Inbound traffic
⑤ `/online` — Online clients and observed source IPs
⑥ `/version` — Local and upstream versions
⑦ `/update` — Update manager and Bot; core updates require confirmation
⑧ `/restart` — Restart Xray after confirmation
⑨ `/language en|zh-CN` — Select interface language

Commands: `/adduser phone`, `/disableuser phone`, `/enableuser phone`.

🔒 Management is limited to authorized private chats. Changes and core updates require explicit permissions.

online.doctor.store:
*Stored observations*
Live users: %d | Recent users: %d | Last poll: `%s`
online.doctor.hint.missing: The core cannot report online IPs for these levels. Repair enables the flags and restarts Xray once.
online.doctor.hint.apifail: The online API did not answer. Check that Xray is running and the Stats API is configured.
online.doctor.hint.empty: The API answered but returned no online users. Confirm the client is connected now, its inbound uses an enabled level, and the core supports online statistics. CDN nodes may report only the CDN edge address.
online.doctor.hint.sessions: Some users have active sessions but no source IP. Xray discards loopback sources (`127.0.0.1` and `[::1]`), so a local relay or port-forward in front of REALITY hides the real client address; an idle client may also have closed every session.
online.doctor.hint.data: The API returned data. If the online card is empty, refresh it.
online.doctor.repairconfirm: Enable statsUserOnline, statsUserUplink and statsUserDownlink for level 0 and every client level, then restart Xray once? Active sessions may reconnect briefly. The configuration is validated and rolled back if startup fails.
online.doctor.repairdone: Online-statistics policy is enabled. Xray was restarted only if the configuration changed. Generate traffic and refresh the online card.
online.doctor.mutations: Remote mutations are disabled. Enable allow_mutations on the VPS.

node.changenote.port: Changes the Xray listener, validates the configuration and restarts Xray. Open the new TCP port in the firewall or security group, update any CDN Origin Rule, and reconfigure the public-port mapping. Active sessions may reconnect.
node.changenote.host: Updates xhttpSettings.host in the server configuration. Clients that pinned the old host must reimport the link.
node.changenote.padding: Updates the server XHTTP padding range. Clients must reimport the link to use the new value.
node.changenote.shortid: Replaces the single REALITY short ID. Clients must update sid or reimport the link.
node.listenportprompt: Current listener port: %d. Enter the new port (1–65535); send /cancel to cancel.
node.listenportinvalid: Listener port must be between 1 and 65535.
node.hostprompt: Current XHTTP host: `%s`. Enter a DNS name or IP without scheme or port, or - to clear; send /cancel to cancel.
node.paddingprompt: Current padding: `%s`. Enter a range such as 100-1000; send /cancel to cancel.
node.shortidprompt: Current short ID: `%s`. Enter 1–8 bytes as even-length hexadecimal, or - to clear; send /cancel to cancel.
node.publicnote: The public port affects exports only; Cloudflare Origin Rules are not modified.
node.mutationsdisabled: Remote mutations are disabled. Enable allow_mutations on the VPS.
node.tokenerror: Unable to generate an operation token
node.changenote.generic: New configuration will be validated and Xray restarted; clients may require updated settings.
node.changenote.publicport: Only export metadata changes; the listener, Cloudflare rules and Xray process remain untouched. Verify your Origin Rule first.
node.changenote.sni: Updates REALITY serverNames and matching default port-443 targets while preserving custom targets. Clients must update SNI.
node.notreality: This inbound does not use REALITY

node.pathinvalid: Invalid path: must begin with /, contain only letters, digits, /, _, -, ., or ~, and be at most 128 characters.
